title: Can't Be Evil NFT License Picker
description: Deterministic rights-matrix lookup mapping creator answers (commercial, exclusivity, hate-speech termination) to one of a16z's six Can't Be Evil NFT licenses (CBE-CC0, ECR, NECR, NECR-HS, PR, PR-HS). Returns license id, Solidity LicenseVersion enum ordinal, full rights matrix, and canonical reference. Selection only, not legal advice. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: cbe_nft_license_picker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps creator rights answers (waive all, commercial use, exclusivity, hate-speech termination) to one of a16z's six Can't Be Evil NFT licenses with the Solidity LicenseVersion enum ordinal, full rights matrix, and canonical reference. Deterministic. Use when a creator or agent needs to pick a standard NFT license to reference from a token contract. Selection only, not legal advice.
